# Part III: Working with Text Fields {.unnumbered}

Much audit data is text. Names of vendors and beneficiaries, addresses, narrations in bank statements, and identifiers like PAN, GSTIN and Aadhaar all arrive as text. They are rarely clean.

This part teaches how to clean and change text, and how to describe patterns with regular expressions. You will use them to validate Indian identifiers, including their check digits, and to pull facts out of free narrations.

Fuzzy matching of names that are spelt differently builds on this part. It comes later, in Part V, next to duplicates and record linkage where it is used.
